chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you err concerning the first two rakʿahs, then repeat them until you establish them with certainty."

key_terms.الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ: the two rakʿahs, meaning two units of salat (prayer)
key_terms.تُثْبِتَهُمَا: you establish them firmly with certainty

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one becomes uncertain in the first two rakʿahs of salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt or forgetfulness in salat (prayer), specifically in the first two rakʿahs. It indicates that when uncertainty affects these foundational units, they are to be repeated until they are established with certainty.
